failure_summary.description: Several trajectories used undefined result variables, called searches inline or more than once, omitted cache saves, or printed results.
Agents repeated searches, ignored compatible cached results, or reprocessed domains unchanged by the latest turn.
Agents mapped a state abbreviation to the city field or substituted attraction category values for the user's wording.
An agent guessed a hotel checkout date instead of requesting the missing required date.
A round trip was represented as an arrival date on the outbound search rather than separate directional flight legs.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly covers assigning and saving tool results, reusing compatible cache entries, mapping state and category values, validating hotel dates without guessing, and searching each round-trip leg separately. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance rather than a missing generalizable rule, so additional edits would duplicate the skill.
